module.name: place
module.label: Feed-forward baseline
module.note: The place module's development file: a feed-forward baseline (development founder 0, 2,000 scenes of the tracking chamber). A program beside the brain holds each place between moments; the brain answers how far a place moves in a step, how far off it may be, and the place a cue names.
